findings.summary: crates/server/tests/github.rs:85-87: the fixture comment says the times 'compare by value, not as text' within the same second. But with gates.rs:36 changed to take(14), which ignores sub-second digits, all github tests still pass. The 03:00:00Z / 03:00:00.500Z tie falls back to stage order, and stage order also puts Verify above Build. Sub-second ordering is not pinned.

crates/server/src/github.rs:228: with Ok(read.last().cloned()) in place of Ok(gates::latest(&read)), all github tests still pass, because the latest-by-time record in the fixture (verify-2) is also the last stage in BTreeMap key order. A fixture where the newest record is not alphabetically last would pin record() choosing by time. The e2e run with the injected build-2.json did choose by time.

crates/server/src/gates.rs:35-37: time() keeps only the digits of an RFC 3339 string, so a non-UTC offset (e.g. +01:00) is treated as part of the time and not converted. Every recorded_at and Linear createdAt seen in this session ends in Z, so this was not observed to go wrong.

Verification environment: the egress proxy authenticates api.github.com reads, so GitHub's real anonymous limit could not be observed. The server sent no token. Stage labels were overridden through the Linear proxy. The merge item used real booking PR #53 served as open, and TRU-6's sent-back case used an injected build-2.json record.
